meta.title: About — Yog-Scope
meta.description: Yog-Scope is a source-available real-time observation platform for Meteora liquidity pools on Solana.

hero.title: Built to observe.
hero.lead: Yog-Scope is a source-available platform that observes liquidity activity on Meteora pools on Solana as it happens, reconstructs the events and exposes them through an API and a dashboard.

problem.title: The problem
problem.big: Tens of thousands of pools, continuous activity, and no public history you can query in real time.
problem.body: Meteora's pools see a continuous flow of swaps, liquidity moves, and fee and reward claims. The chain does not natively offer a public, real-time, queryable history of that activity.

approach.title: The approach
approach.body: A permanent stream from a Solana node captures Meteora's events as soon as they are emitted. Each event is decoded, enriched with token metadata and USD prices, then stored in a time-series database.

capture.label: Capture
capture.body: A continuous stream from a Solana node

approach.outro: Each protocol has its own decoder, which understands its own events: no generic adapter smoothing the differences away. We start with Meteora, and the history builds up over time.

lp.label: LP
lp.title: Liquidity providers
lp.body: Watch the pools where they hold positions.

market.label: Market
market.title: Analysts and traders
market.body: Query pool history to spot patterns, large movements and imbalances.

api.label: API
api.title: Developers
api.body: A typed HTTP API over Meteora's activity, without building their own indexer.

availability.title: How it's available
availability.premium: Premium features may be added later. The public code and the free public access stay.

behind.title: Who is behind it
behind.tagline: An independent software company, based in France.
